subject: reasoning
question:
Anil starts from point A and drives 7 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, then turns left, and drives 9 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km, and stops at point P.

How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?

(All turns are 90° turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

Anil starts from point A and drives 7 km towards the east.

He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km.

Then turns left, and drives 9 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km, and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db86adef9ce6ecea39acb3e2966a507982616a2cea1f2c9513fd7f4e6d91073d.png] 

So, Anil has to drive **'6km towards the south'** direction to reach point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
